page_note: 该页为《European Innovation Scoreboard 2025》第65页，上方是浅蓝底的国家表现文字框，中部为Figure 25（Moderate Innovators 表现，左右两个折线面板），下方是斜体Note和"Emerging Innovators"正文段落。

components.evidence: right panel has no legend; "Malta", "Slovenia", "Italy", "Spain", "Portugal", "Cyprus", "Lithuania", "Czechia", "Greece", "Croatia" printed at line ends
"Summary innovation index" set vertically along the y axis of both panels
axis ticks are bare 50–120; only "Summary innovation index" names the scale
lowest tick on both panels is "50" with no break glyph on the axis
Note: "Performance is relative to that of the EU in 2018" under the plot

new_components.name: aggregate_panel_beside_members_panel
new_components.evidence: Note: "The graph on the left shows the average performance of the Moderate Innovators"; right panel shows each state
new_components.why_it_matters: 左面板的线没有任何系列名（只是组平均），取值时必须用"average of the Moderate Innovators"这类注释文字来定位，而不能靠图例或标签。

new_components.name: crowded_endpoint_label_stack
new_components.evidence: "Malta/Slovenia/Italy/Spain/Portugal" labels stack and touch at right edge, matched to lines by colour only
new_components.why_it_matters: 标签互相挤压且与线端点错位，读某一国2025年的点必须靠颜色配对，容易把102.6与102.4张冠李戴。

new_components.name: cross_figure_axis_span_note
new_components.evidence: Note: "All vertical scales in Figure 23–Figure 26 span a range of 70.0%-points"
new_components.why_it_matters: 说明纵轴范围是跨图统一约定（50–120共70点），提示不能按面板自适应缩放来估算刻度。

difficulty_notes: 右面板10条线在'23–'25之间全部挤进100–110这一格半的空间里，纵轴刻度间隔为10点，5%容差在100附近约为5点，即半格；但Malta 106.4、Slovenia 102.6、Italy 102.4三条线彼此相差不到2点（约0.2格），从像素上既分不出数值也分不清是哪一国的线，端点标签还叠在一起。图上没有任何数字标注（values_printed=none），左面板的平均线更连系列名都没有，只能靠Note里的一句话认领，因此"把数读到5%以内并归到正确系列"是最主要的障碍；88个点的密度也使逐点计数只能估算。
